name: @luckylillia/plugin-proxy
description: The proxy (http / socks5) for what plugins send through ctx.http, e.g. the AI gateway calling OpenAI. The bot itself connects directly

description.zh: 插件访问外网用的代理（http / socks5），比如 AI 网关连 OpenAI。只管插件经 ctx.http 发的请求，Bot 自己登录、收发图片都直连
description.en: The proxy (http / socks5) for what plugins send through ctx.http, e.g. the AI gateway calling OpenAI. The bot itself connects directly
